%% Calibration deck: bullet lists, depth 1 to 4, wrapped lines, a tall item, a footnote.
\setSlideVersion{1-0-0}
\begin{standardframe}{Bullet lists, four levels deep}
	\begin{itemize}
		\item Level one, a long item that wraps onto a second line so that the gap between wrapped lines can be compared with the gap between items\footnote{A footnote below the lists.}
		\begin{itemize}
			\item Level two, also long enough to wrap onto a second line when the column is narrow enough for it
			\begin{itemize}
				\item Level three
				\begin{itemize}
					\item Level four, long enough to wrap onto a second line when the text is longer than one line
					\item Level four again
				\end{itemize}
				\item Level three again
			\end{itemize}
		\end{itemize}
		\tallitem A tall item: $S=\dfrac{E[R]-r_f}{\sigma}$
		\tallitem The item after it
	\end{itemize}
\end{standardframe}
